_comment: Accepted Plugin Check findings. Gate: shared-build-tools/check-plugincheck-parity.php, which runs WordPress.org's OWN Plugin Check sniffs. This list is EMPTY and must stay empty: the policy is zero errors and zero warnings from the reviewer's tool. Genuine false positives are suppressed at the line with a `phpcs:ignore PluginCheck.<code> -- reason` annotation, which Plugin Check honours (it has no --ignore-annotations option), so the reviewer sees a clean report too. An entry appearing here means something was accepted rather than resolved.
